card.name: Linking words in all-caps warning headings
card.fires_on: The word or comma that follows an all-caps heading word, such as AND after DRUG ABUSE or a comma after ABUSE, in label warning headings and cross-references. Also the final S in MEDICATIONS in the all-caps child warning.

modes.label: AND in DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE
modes.description: The word AND inside the capitalized section name DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE, usually in a see-reference.
modes.example: (see DRUG ABUSE<< AND>> DEPENDENCE and CLINICAL PH

modes.label: Boxed warning heading separators
modes.description: The comma after ABUSE in the boxed warning title about opioid risks.
modes.example: WARNING: RISKS FROM CONCOMITANT USE WITH OPIOIDS ; ABUSE<<,>> MISUSE, AND ADDICTION;

modes.label: Other all-caps warning text
modes.description: Words inside other all-caps warning sentences, like the S of MEDICATIONS or THE after LOWER.
modes.example: KEEP THIS AND ALL MEDICATION<<S>> OUT OF THE REACH OF CHILDREN

card.writes: It seems to push the next word to begin with a short letter start, such as st, d, f or tr, in all-caps text.
card.plain: It fires on joining words and punctuation inside capitalized label headings, especially DRUG ABUSE AND DEPENDENCE.
